DISASSEMBLY OF FORWARD CLUTCH

1. REMOVE FORWARD CLUTCH ASSEMBLY FROM DIRECT CLUTCH ASSEMBLY

D4833

2. PLACE FORWARD CLUTCH ONTO OVERDRIVE SUPPORT

(a) Place wooden blocks, etc. to prevent forward clutch shaft from touching the work stand, and place the O/D support on them.

(b) Place the forward clutch onto the O/D support.

D4834
